import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxN = 70;
    static final int maxn = 50;
    static final int lim = 22;
    static long[][] C = new long[maxN + 5][maxN + 5];
    static int n, m, N;
    static int mid;
    static int[] g;
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<ArrayList<Pair>>> partb;
    static HashMap<Long, Long>[][] parta;
    static long ans;
    static long ans_cnt;

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;
        Pair(long f, int s) { first = f; second = s; }
    }

    static void prepare() {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxN; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static void dfs_partb(int x, int cnta, int cntb, long sum) {
        if (x == mid) {
            partb.get(cnta).get(cntb).add(new Pair(sum, 1));
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            if (g[x - 1] != -1 && i != g[x - 1]) continue;
            long tmp = 0;
            if (i == 0) {
                if (cnta > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta - 1, cntb, sum + tmp);
                }
            } else {
                if (cntb > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta, cntb - 1, sum + tmp);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void update(long val, long cnt) {
        if (val < ans) {
            ans = val;
            ans_cnt = cnt;
        } else if (val == ans) {
            ans_cnt += cnt;
        }
    }

    static int binarySearch(ArrayList<Pair> list, long key) {
        int lo = 0, hi = list.size();
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid).first < key) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        return lo;
    }

    static void bfs_parta() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                parta[i][j].clear();
            }
        }
        parta[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> u : parta[i][j].entrySet()) {
                    long ux = u.getKey();
                    long uy = u.getValue();
                    if (i + j == mid) {
                        int p = binarySearch(partb.get(i).get(j), -ux);
                        if (p < partb.get(i).get(j).size()) {
                            Pair pr = partb.get(i).get(j).get(p);
                            update(Math.abs(ux + pr.first), uy * pr.second);
                        }
                        if (p > 0) {
                            Pair pr = partb.get(i).get(j).get(p - 1);
                            update(Math.abs(ux + pr.first), uy * pr.second);
                        }
                    } else {
                        int p = i + j;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
                            if (g[p] != -1 && k != g[p]) continue;
                            int cnta = i, cntb = j;
                            if (k == 0) cnta++;
                            else cntb++;
                            if (cnta <= n + m && cntb <= n + m) {
                                long tmp = 0;
                                if (k == 0) {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                }
                                long newkey = ux + tmp;
                                parta[cnta][cntb].merge(newkey, uy, Long::sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void work() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                partb.get(i).get(j).clear();
            }
        }
        dfs_partb(N, n + m, n + m);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                ArrayList<Pair> list = partb.get(i).get(j);
                list.sort((p1, p2) -> Long.compare(p1.first, p2.first));
                ArrayList<Pair> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
                int sz = list.size();
                for (int k = 0; k < sz; ) {
                    long cur = list.get(k).first;
                    int cnt = 0;
                    while (k < sz && list.get(k).first == cur) {
                        cnt += list.get(k).second;
                        k++;
                    }
                    tmp.add(new Pair(cur, cnt));
                }
                partb.get(i).set(j, tmp);
            }
        }
        bfs_parta();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        prepare();
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        String s = sc.next();
        N = (n + m) * 2;
        mid = Math.max(0, N - lim);
        g = new int[maxN + 5];
        Arrays.fill(g, -1);

        partb = new ArrayList<>(maxn + 5);
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxn + 4; i++) {
            partb.add(new ArrayList<>(maxn + 5));
            for (int j = 0; j <= maxn + 4; j++) {
                partb.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }
        parta = new HashMap[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn + 5; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < maxn + 5; j++) {
                parta[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }

        work();

        ans_cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == 'A') g[i] = 0;
            else if (c == 'B') g[i] = 1;
        }

        work();

        System.out.println(ans_cnt);
    }
}
